text:
lucy_prod: Quick sync from the onboarding demo: the in-app help panel labels the feature as "Shortcuts" but the Console menu and docs use "Routes". Users hit the help link and get different terminology, which is confusing.

danielle_design: Thanks. The snippet generator pulls raw text from the docs index so stale words slip through. We should either canonicalize at build-time or sanitize snippets at render.

owen_docs: I did a site grep: found 6 pages still mentioning "Shortcuts". There's also some external links that reference old anchors. My proposal: pick a canonical term (recommend "Routes") and ship a redirects.json map for legacy hashes + a small banner when we redirect.

kevin_eng: Two additional issues:
1) anchors are case-sensitive and our CDN was serving an older build for ~12 hrs last week, so many deep links effectively landed at page top. We'll need a CDN purge as part of the fix.
2) some headings auto-generate slugs when punctuation changes, causing hash churn. We should emit stable slugs in frontmatter (canonical_slug) to avoid future churn.

access-bot: a11y: if we open docs in a modal, ensure role="dialog" and focus the H1/H2 after mount. Also add skip links in the doc so screen readers can move to the content. Confirmed contrast on the help snippet in dark mode is <4.5:1.

lucy_prod: Also want telemetry: emit a docs_help_click event and a docs_redirect event if we remap a legacy hash (include original_hash). Helps product decide if we need redirects long-term.

owen_docs: Agreed. Example redirects mapping I'm adding to the build:
```json
{"shortcuts":"routes","shortcut-keys":"routes-keys"}
```
I'll add a tiny banner: "You were redirected from a legacy link " (actual banner text shorter in PR).

kevin_eng: Implementation plan: small lambda resolver that returns final anchor + X-Redirected-From header when a remap occurs, client SDK will emit docs_redirect telemetry. Also add a feature flag to toggle client-side replacement for quick rollback. I'll include CDN purge step in the deployment runbook.

danielle_design: UI plan: switch panel to minitoc + one-line summary + explicit "Open full docs" (new tab). Avoid long excerpts to reduce stale copy surface. I'll also tweak color tokens to fix contrast.

lucy_prod: Owners: owen_docs -> canonical terms + redirects.json + banner; kevin_eng -> resolver + telemetry + CDN purge; danielle_design -> help panel copy + contrast; access-bot -> a11y signoff. Timeline: PRs by Tue, canary Wed. Please @ me on PRs.

owen_docs: I'll start the PR and paste the redirect example. If anyone has lingering pages with "Shortcuts" paste links here and Ill update them in the build.

lucy_prod: Thanks all, small but important. We'll reconvene after canary metrics. :raised_hands:
